# signoz_saved_view (Resource)



-> **Requires SigNoz >= v0.137.0.** `signoz_saved_view` uses the v2 saved views API (`/api/v2/saved_views`), available on SigNoz v0.137.0 and later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A saved view on the Logs explore page: errors for one service, rendered as a
# list with a handful of columns selected. See the schema below for all attributes.

resource "signoz_saved_view" "api_service_errors" {
  name           = "api-service-errors"
  source         = "logs"
  schema_version = "v2"

  spec = {
    display_name = "API service errors"
    panel_type   = "list"
    request_type = "raw"

    queries = [
      {
        builder_query = {
          type = "builder_query"
          spec = {
            logs = {
              name   = "A"
              signal = "logs"

              filter = {
                expression = "service.name = 'api-service' AND severity_text = 'ERROR'"
              }

              order = [
                {
                  direction = "desc"
                  key = {
                    name = "timestamp"
                  }
                }
              ]

              limit = 100
            }
          }
        }
      }
    ]

    selected_fields = [
      {
        name = "timestamp"
      },
      {
        name            = "service.name"
        field_context   = "resource"
        field_data_type = "string"
      },
      {
        name            = "severity_text"
        field_data_type = "string"
      },
      {
        name            = "body"
        field_context   = "body"
        field_data_type = "string"
      },
    ]

    display = {
      font_size = "small"
      format    = "list"
      max_lines = 2
    }
  }
}
```

```terraform
resource "signoz_saved_view" "minimal" {
  name           = "minimal-required-only"
  source         = "logs"
  schema_version = "v2"

  spec = {
    display_name = "Minimal"
    panel_type   = "list"
    request_type = "raw"

    queries = [
      {
        builder_query = {
          type = "builder_query"
          spec = {
            logs = {
              name   = "A"
              signal = "logs"
            }
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

```terraform
# A saved view on the Traces explore page: slow checkout spans, grouped by
# operation and rendered as a table.

resource "signoz_saved_view" "checkout_slow_spans" {
  name           = "checkout-slow-spans"
  source         = "traces"
  schema_version = "v2"

  spec = {
    display_name = "Checkout slow spans"
    panel_type   = "table"
    request_type = "scalar"

    queries = [
      {
        builder_query = {
          type = "builder_query"
          spec = {
            traces = {
              name   = "A"
              signal = "traces"

              aggregations = [
                {
                  expression = "p99(duration_nano)"
                }
              ]

              filter = {
                expression = "service.name = 'checkout' AND duration_nano > 500000000"
              }

              group_by = [
                {
                  name            = "name"
                  field_context   = "span"
                  field_data_type = "string"
                }
              ]

              limit = 50
            }
          }
        }
      }
    ]

    selected_fields = [
      {
        name            = "name"
        field_context   = "span"
        field_data_type = "string"
      },
      {
        name            = "duration_nano"
        field_context   = "span"
        field_data_type = "number"
      },
    ]

    display = {
      format = "table"
    }
  }
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Saved views are imported using their ID.
terraform import signoz_saved_view.api_service_errors 0192a9c2-1234-7abc-8def-0123456789ab
```
